calibration: conformal PID with nested selection, then Platt out of fold (pressure.RECALIBRATION), as published_v1, in each of the inputs combined
inputs_note: the direct-pairs twin's calibrated probability on a day flagged by the scorecaster calendar (month end, quarter end, tax date, coupon settlement), published_v1's on every other day. At h = 1 only: the variants are h = 1 objects, so at h = 2 to 5 the probability is published_v1's exactly. Declared in the amendment of metadata/turning_point_variant.json, before any pressure score
